If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.

If sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67) and forecast is trending upward, cap upward revisions at +1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.

If sentiment is positive but forecast is trending downward, add 0.5–1.0% downward bias for early horizon to align with sentiment momentum.

If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending upward, reduce upward momentum by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon to reflect sentiment drag.

If sentiment is positive and forecast is near peak, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to avoid overbought bias.
